How to use Excel to XML

Convert chosen workbook sheets into XML and other available exports.

Input: application/vnd.ms-excel, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet. Output: application/pdf, application/vnd.ms-excel, application/vnd.oasis.opendocument.spreadsheet, application/xml, application/zip, text/csv.

Select XLSX or XLS workbooks, or import a public workbook URL.

Convert and download, then verify the XML structure.
Processing, privacy and limitations
How are my files processed?
Local workbooks are processed in a browser worker. URL import sends the requested URL to the server for fetching.
